title: Air National Guard Impact 65 Days After Hurricane Maria
description: A visual representation of the Air National Guard impact in Puerto Rico more than two months after Hurricane Maria hit the U.S. Territory.  The video includes the number of Puerto Rico Air National Guard sorties, flight hours, passengers and cargo; the current total of ANG personnel from 29 different states, mobile kitchen, medical group, emergency family assistance centers, civil engineering projects, and more.
